goal: Drive a Deployment through three revisions of the MFS Freight Portal, make maxSurge and maxUnavailable arithmetic visible during the update, then wedge the rollout with a bad image and recover with rollout undo.
produces: A freight-portal Deployment at revision 2 serving the r24.2 page, with a readable rollout history and change-cause column
A wedged revision 3 stuck in ImagePullBackOff while the old ReplicaSet keeps 4 Pods Available
A verified rollback to revision 2 confirmed by curl through the ClusterIP Service
concepts: A Deployment owns ReplicaSets; a ReplicaSet owns Pods - rollouts are ReplicaSet scaling, not Pod mutation
maxSurge sets the ceiling (replicas + surge) and maxUnavailable sets the floor (replicas - unavailable)
rollout status / history / undo, kubernetes.io/change-cause and revisionHistoryLimit
.spec.selector is immutable on an existing Deployment
